messages:
anya: Quick check — can we lock the public changelog and docs links for Thursday's announce? I want the marketing post, webinar CTA, and embed badges to point to final URLs.

sophie: Working on the changelog PR now. Need to confirm that the model rollout fallback is documented in the notes. I pushed a draft to staging docs: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-26

eli: Webinar timing reminder: we planned 10:00 PT on Thu. Does that still align with the rollout window? We prefer the announce to go ~5m before webinar email lands.

marco: Deploy window for the host API is 09:50–10:10 PT (canary first 09:50–09:55). If marketing wants announce at 09:55 PT that's doable. Full rollout finishes ~10:05 PT.

anya: OK — proposed announce at 09:55 PT then webinar email at 10:00 PT. Sophie, can you confirm changelog and docs prod links by EOD tomorrow?

sophie: Yes. I'll merge the changelog PR after one more review and flip the docs from staging to prod. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

sophie: changelog snippet (preview):
```
- Improved adaptive batching defaults for short-context workloads
- Added rollout fallback to quantized-v2 when memory pressure > 85%
- Fixed rare NPE in streaming pipe that affected long prompts
```

eli: For the marketing post, do we have a canonical benchmark image link and alt text? We should embed the image hosted on CDN-prod, not staging.

anya: I uploaded the final benchmark graphic to assets: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/launch/bench-2026-03-26.png (alt: "Latency and cost per 1k tokens across workloads — March 2026"). Use that one.

marco: I'll ensure the CDN path is ready and the URL will be accessible by 09:30 PT. Also setting a rollback flag on the deployment if errors spike > 3xx thresholds.

sophie: Docs prod URL after flip will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-26 — I'll paste the exact anchor for the fallback section when live.

anya: Two final asks: 1) a one-line changelog excerpt for the tweet thread, 2) confirm the /announce endpoint will return 200 at the announce moment. Anyone can ping the healthcheck?

eli: One-liner for social: "Faster, cheaper inference — new adaptive-batching defaults, improved fallback for quantized models, and better streaming stability." Shorten as needed.

marco: Healthcheck endpoint (/v1/announce/health) will be checked by ops at T-2m, +1m automation. I'll post the status here.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by marco for canary: 1799990600, full: 1799990700; watch: ops-channel.

marco: Healthcheck at 09:53 PT: 200 OK, 95%ile latency 38ms. All good.

sophie: Merged changelog PR. Docs flip queued — will go live on merge. Prod anchor for fallback: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-26#rollout-fallbacks

anya: Thank you all. If nobody objects we'll ship the announce at 09:55 PT and trigger webinar email at 10:00 PT. Please :thumbsup: in-thread when confirmed.

eli: :thumbsup:

marco: :thumbsup: will monitor rollback flags.

sophie: :thumbsup: docs link live.

anya: Great — closing loop. I'll post the final copy and link bundle in #marketing-announce 10m before.
